Hi everyone! I just wanted to ask about the Ramat Gan branch.

Do we need to submit the required documents 3 months before the interview date? We only received the interview notification this month, and our interview is scheduled for September, so it’s less than 3 months away.

I’d really appreciate hearing from anyone who has gone through the process at the Ramat Gan branch. Thank you!
